messages.subject: "unexpected genotype codes" error
parts:
I was given the following error message and have not been able to fix
it. :

"The following unexpected genotype codes were treated as missing.
| | in: read.cross.csv(dir, file, na.strings, genotypes,
estimate.map, "

Does this mean that a genotype is missing and there is not a dash, or
does this indicate another problem?

messages.author: f388084a0de67b60
messages.subject: Re: "unexpected genotype codes" error
parts:
Yes, it means that there was a blank cell in your file.
The vertical bars are used to delimit the different
unexpected codes.

karl
